data.comment: Thanks for the review! Changes since the first submission:  - Hiss sounds (S, SH, F, H, Z): 27 syllables now start at the end of the high-frequency cloud in the spectrum instead of at its start, and line-final S sounds are included in the line. - Line ends: 8 lines that ended too early (cutting off a held note) or too late were moved to where the voice actually stops. - Early/late syllables: the chorus repeats 2-3 times with the same delivery; 10 syllables that were timed differently across repetitions were re-synced against the spectrum to match the others. The repeated "let" now uses the same \kf in every repetition. - Added a singer legend at the start of the song (first 10 seconds, bottom of the screen) as suggested: jen (orange, lead vocals) | Neptune (blue, rap). The choir is shown in green italics in the lyrics. - Metadata: added Merfie to the songwriters (co-composer, per the official credits).
